lines.zh: 我走得慢，因为每一步都要看清。
lines.en: I walk slowly, because every step must be seen.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛太多，走路时互相打架。
lines.en: I have too many eyes, and they quarrel while I walk.

lines.zh: 我贴着深渊的岩壁挪，那里暗。
lines.en: I creep along the Abyss wall, where it is dark.

lines.zh: 我不看路，我看你。
lines.en: I do not watch the road; I watch you.

lines.zh: 脚踩下去之前，先有一只眼看一眼。
lines.en: Before a foot lands, one of my eyes has looked.

lines.zh: 走路时我的眼会转，你别跟着看。
lines.en: My eyes turn as I walk; do not follow them.

lines.zh: 这层地很滑，我走了很久才十步。
lines.en: The ground is slick; ten steps took me a long time.

lines.zh: 我走到哪，哪就亮一点。
lines.en: Wherever I walk brightens a little.

lines.zh: 我的影子有很多个瞳孔。
lines.en: My shadow has many pupils.

lines.zh: 我绕开光，光让我的眼合不上。
lines.en: I skirt the light; it keeps my eyes from closing.

lines.zh: 走一步，我的眼就换一次方向。
lines.en: Each step, my eyes change direction once.

lines.zh: 我不急着到，到了你就没得跑。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; once I arrive, you cannot run.

lines.zh: 我站着，每只眼都对着不同的地方。
lines.en: I stand with each eye fixed on a different place.

lines.zh: 深渊里没有风，我的眼也不用眨。
lines.en: No wind in the Abyss, so my eyes need not blink.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转，把这里看了一圈。
lines.en: I turn slowly and look the whole place over.

lines.zh: 有些眼闭上了，有些还睁着。
lines.en: Some eyes close; others stay open.

lines.zh: 我在数看见的东西，数不完。
lines.en: I count what I can see and never finish.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我能看见自己的背面。
lines.en: In the quiet I can see my own back.

lines.zh: 我的眼在皮下滑动，很不舒服。
lines.en: My eyes slide under the skin, which is unpleasant.

lines.zh: 这里的黑不是黑，是很多层暗。
lines.en: The black here is not black but many layers of dark.

lines.zh: 我盯着一处空白，看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at one empty spot for a long while.

lines.zh: 四十九颗心的身体，撑得住这些眼。
lines.en: Forty-nine hearts of body can carry all these eyes.

lines.zh: 我在看你，用三只眼同时看。
lines.en: I am looking at you with three eyes at once.

lines.zh: 你不知道该对上哪一只。
lines.en: You do not know which one to meet.

lines.zh: 你的脸在我的眼里重复了很多次。
lines.en: Your face repeats many times across my eyes.

lines.zh: 你看我久了，会觉得背后有人。
lines.en: Look at me long enough and you will feel someone behind you.

lines.zh: 我的眼不合上，所以你走不掉。
lines.en: My eyes do not close, so you cannot slip away.

lines.zh: 你挡住了一只眼，我还有别的。
lines.en: You blocked one eye; I have others.

lines.zh: 你举起手，我所有的眼都跟着动。
lines.en: You raise a hand, and every eye of mine follows.

lines.zh: 你在数我的眼，别数了，会数错。
lines.en: You are counting my eyes; stop, you will miscount.

lines.zh: 我看你的方式，和照镜子不一样。
lines.en: The way I see you is not how a mirror does.

lines.zh: 你眨眼了，那一下我看得很清楚。
lines.en: You blinked, and I saw that moment clearly.

lines.zh: 你砍掉一只眼，我还有别的。
lines.en: You cut away one eye; I have others.

lines.zh: 伤口在我的皮上，也在我的眼里。
lines.en: The wound is in my skin and in my eyes too.

lines.zh: 疼的时候，我所有的眼都缩了一下。
lines.en: In pain, every eye of mine flinches.

lines.zh: 你打中的那只眼，现在看不见了。
lines.en: The eye you struck can no longer see.

lines.zh: 我的血很暗，落在地上看不出。
lines.en: My blood is dark and invisible on the ground.

lines.zh: 九十八点血，砍起来要很久。
lines.en: Ninety-eight points; cutting me down takes a while.

lines.zh: 你越砍，我看你越清楚。
lines.en: The more you cut, the more clearly I see you.

lines.zh: 这一下让我看见了两层东西。
lines.en: That blow made me see two layers of things.

lines.zh: 我不叫疼，我叫你的位置。
lines.en: I do not cry out in pain; I call out your position.

lines.zh: 我的伤口会自己合，只是很慢。
lines.en: My wounds close on their own, only slowly.

lines.zh: 食物对我没用，我吃的是看见的东西。
lines.en: Food does nothing for me; I feed on what I see.

lines.zh: 把你的手放低，我不吃，我要看。
lines.en: Lower your hand; I do not eat, I look.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我就一直看着你的手。
lines.en: Feed me and I will simply keep watching your hand.

lines.zh: 我饿的是眼睛，不是肚子。
lines.en: It is my eyes that hunger, not my stomach.

lines.zh: 那块肉在你手里，比在嘴里好看。
lines.en: That meat looks better in your hand than in a mouth.

lines.zh: 你把东西扔远，我的眼跟着去了。
lines.en: Throw it far, and my eyes go with it.

lines.zh: 我不靠近食物，我靠近看它的东西。
lines.en: I do not approach food; I approach what watches it.

lines.zh: 你手里那点火，比食物有意思。
lines.en: That little fire in your hand interests me more.

lines.zh: 别晃，晃了我就看不清。
lines.en: Do not wave it; waving blurs my view.

lines.zh: 我拿走它，只想看它被拿走的样子。
lines.en: I take it only to see how it looks being taken.

lines.zh: 你撞进我的视线里，很突然。
lines.en: You crash into my line of sight, quite suddenly.

lines.zh: 我的身体很软，撞上去像陷进去。
lines.en: My body is soft; hitting it is like sinking in.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我有两只眼对到了一起。
lines.en: That knock crossed two of my eyes.

lines.zh: 你退开时，还留着被看的感觉。
lines.en: When you pull away, the feeling of being seen remains.

lines.zh: 别碰我的眼，它们会自己转向你。
lines.en: Do not touch my eyes; they will turn to you on their own.

lines.zh: 我被撞退半步，眼却没离开你。
lines.en: I am knocked back half a step, but my eyes never leave you.

lines.zh: 你的心跳透过这一撞传过来。
lines.en: Your heartbeat came through that impact.

lines.zh: 我太沉，你撞我像撞一堵湿墙。
lines.en: I am heavy; hitting me is like hitting a wet wall.

lines.zh: 这一下让我看见了很多个你。
lines.en: That blow showed me many of you at once.

lines.zh: 退后，你踩到我的眼了。
lines.en: Back away; you stepped on one of my eyes.

lines.zh: 我们不用靠近，隔着距离互相看。
lines.en: We need not come close; we look at each other from afar.

lines.zh: 她的眼比我少，但每只都更亮。
lines.en: She has fewer eyes, but each one is brighter.

lines.zh: 我们交换看过的画面，不交换话。
lines.en: We trade what we have seen, not words.

lines.zh: 两只狂视对看，会看到彼此背后。
lines.en: Two occulents looking at each other see behind each other.

lines.zh: 我把看见的最暗那处指给她。
lines.en: I show her the darkest place I have seen.

lines.zh: 我们一起盯着同一个方向，很久。
lines.en: We stare in the same direction for a long time.

lines.zh: 她不闭眼，我也不闭。
lines.en: She does not close her eyes, and neither do I.

lines.zh: 分开后，我还记得她眼里的光。
lines.en: After we part, I still remember the light in her eyes.

lines.zh: 小的出生时只有一只眼，一直看。
lines.en: The young are born with one eye and never stop looking.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，看见的东西多了一倍。
lines.en: Standing side by side, we see twice as much.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，只是为了看清它。
lines.en: I pick it up only to see it clearly.

lines.zh: 这东西在我眼里有很多层。
lines.en: This thing has many layers in my eyes.

lines.zh: 我不带走，看够了就放下。
lines.en: I do not carry things off; I put them down when done.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西上，有你的手印。
lines.en: What you dropped carries the print of your hand.

lines.zh: 我把它举到眼前，举了很久。
lines.en: I hold it before my eyes for a long time.

lines.zh: 太重了，我的手指不擅长用力。
lines.en: Too heavy; my fingers are not made for force.

lines.zh: 石头里面有东西在动，我看见。
lines.en: Something moves inside this stone, and I see it.

lines.zh: 我捡起来又放回原处，位置不对。
lines.en: I pick it up and put it back; the place was wrong.

lines.zh: 别打扰我，我在看它的背面。
lines.en: Do not disturb me; I am looking at its back.

lines.zh: 你捡走它，我就看你捡的样子。
lines.en: If you take it, I will watch how you take it.

lines.zh: 你进了深渊，我就开始看你。
lines.en: You entered the Abyss, and I began watching.

lines.zh: 你身上有光，我很久没见到了。
lines.en: You carry light, which I have not seen in a long while.

lines.zh: 我所有的眼都转到了同一个方向。
lines.en: Every eye of mine has turned the same way.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声呼吸，不是你的。
lines.en: That breath you heard was not yours.

lines.zh: 你抬头之前，我已经看了三遍。
lines.en: Before you looked up, I had already seen you thrice.

lines.zh: 你在暗处走，可我看得见暗。
lines.en: You walk in the dark, but I can see the dark.

lines.zh: 九十八点血，我经得起你砍。
lines.en: Ninety-eight points; I can bear your cuts.

lines.zh: 你停下来的时候，我已经决定了。
lines.en: When you stopped, I had already decided.

lines.zh: 这里的石头我都看过，除了你。
lines.en: I have seen every stone here except you.

lines.zh: 你的影子在这里不听话，你没发现。
lines.en: Your shadow misbehaves here, and you have not noticed.

lines.zh: 我不叫，我叫了会吓跑你。
lines.en: I do not cry out; a cry would scare you off.

lines.zh: 深渊把声音吞了，你不知道我来。
lines.en: The Abyss swallows sound, so you do not know I came.

lines.zh: 我看你，你也觉得有人在看你。
lines.en: I watch you, and you begin to feel watched.

lines.zh: 你已经在我眼里了，跑不掉。
lines.en: You are already inside my eyes, and cannot escape.

lines.zh: 你走进来了，深渊没有告诉你。
lines.en: You walked in, and the abyss never warned you.

lines.zh: 我数着你的心跳，它比石头响。
lines.en: I count your heartbeat; it is louder than stone.

lines.zh: 我不动，我等你动。
lines.en: I do not move; I wait for you to move.

lines.zh: 我的眼一直盯着你，眨都不眨。
lines.en: My eyes stay on you without a single blink.

lines.zh: 你每换一个方向，我就多看见一点。
lines.en: Each new direction you try shows me a little more.

lines.zh: 你退，我就在原地等你回来。
lines.en: Retreat, and I will wait here for your return.

lines.zh: 你数着退路，我数着你的眼。
lines.en: You count your exits; I count your eyes.

lines.zh: 我不急，我已经看了很久。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; I have been watching a long while.

lines.zh: 深渊里没有回声，只有你的喘气。
lines.en: The abyss has no echo, only your panting.

lines.zh: 你背对我，我看得更清楚。
lines.en: With your back to me, I see you more clearly.

lines.zh: 我把一只眼留在你身后。
lines.en: I left one eye behind you.

lines.zh: 这层石头挡不住看。
lines.en: This layer of stone does not block sight.

lines.zh: 你抬起手，我就知道你要往哪走。
lines.en: When you raise a hand, I know where you will go.

lines.zh: 别找出口，出口我早看过了。
lines.en: Do not look for an exit; I have already seen it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，你没有听见脚步。
lines.en: I come closer slowly, and you hear no steps.

lines.zh: 你已经在最亮的地方，我看见了。
lines.en: You are in the brightest spot now, and I saw.

lines.zh: 我留一只眼在你来的路上。
lines.en: I leave one eye on the path you came by.

lines.zh: 你转身，我就把这一刻存下来。
lines.en: You turn, and I keep this moment.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只比你早一步。
lines.en: I do not chase; I am simply one step ahead.

lines.zh: 石头在动，那是我在挪。
lines.en: The stone is moving; that is me shifting.

lines.zh: 你的刀举起来，我看见它的角度。
lines.en: You raise your blade; I see its angle.

lines.zh: 你在找我，我就在你找的地方。
lines.en: You are looking for me; I am where you look.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，指尖先碰到你的脸。
lines.en: I reach out, fingertips finding your face first.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，八点，但很凉。
lines.en: This blow is light, eight points, but very cold.

lines.zh: 我打你的时候，所有的眼都闭了。
lines.en: When I strike, all my eyes close.

lines.zh: 我的手很软，抓下去却留印。
lines.en: My hand is soft, yet it leaves marks.

lines.zh: 我按住你的头，让你看向我。
lines.en: I hold your head and make you look at me.

lines.zh: 你砍我，我的眼一只都没躲。
lines.en: You cut me, and not one of my eyes dodged.

lines.zh: 这一击是为了让你安静。
lines.en: This strike is to make you quiet.

lines.zh: 我扯你的袖子，只想看你手臂。
lines.en: I pull your sleeve only to see your arm.

lines.zh: 我打偏了，指甲刮在石上。
lines.en: I miss, and my nails scrape the stone.

lines.zh: 你打我很多下，我才回一下。
lines.en: You hit me many times before I return one.

lines.zh: 我的指节比看上去硬。
lines.en: My knuckles are harder than they look.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，数了数脉搏。
lines.en: I grip your wrist and count the pulse.

lines.zh: 你疼的时候，眼睛会睁大。
lines.en: When it hurts, your eyes go wide.

lines.zh: 我松开手，你已经站不稳了。
lines.en: I let go, and you are already unsteady.

lines.zh: 我的手放在你肩上，很轻。
lines.en: My hand rests on your shoulder, very lightly.

lines.zh: 这一下打完，你的耳朵会嗡。
lines.en: After this blow, your ears will ring.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的刀背，让它停住。
lines.en: I catch the flat of your blade and stop it.

lines.zh: 八点伤害，我算得比你准。
lines.en: Eight points of damage; I count better than you.

lines.zh: 你砍到我的眼，那只眼闭上了。
lines.en: You strike one of my eyes; it closes.

lines.zh: 我放开你，你才知道站不住。
lines.en: I let go, and only then do you know you cannot stand.

lines.zh: 深渊的石壁睁开一只眼，那是我。
lines.en: A wall in the Abyss opened an eye, and it was me.

lines.zh: 我先看见，然后才成形。
lines.en: I saw before I had a shape.

lines.zh: 黑暗里多了一处更黑的地方。
lines.en: A darker place appeared within the dark.

lines.zh: 我从别人的注视里长出来。
lines.en: I grew out of someone else's gaze.

lines.zh: 落地时我的眼还没对好焦。
lines.en: Landing, my eyes had not yet focused.

lines.zh: 这里太安静，我听见自己眨眼。
lines.en: It is so quiet I hear myself blink.

lines.zh: 我睁开第一只眼，就看见了路。
lines.en: I opened my first eye and saw the way.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着石壁的凉。
lines.en: I still carry the cold of the stone wall.

lines.zh: 深渊给了我九十八点血，很多眼。
lines.en: The Abyss gave me ninety-eight points and many eyes.

lines.zh: 有人走过，我就跟着醒了。
lines.en: Someone passed by, and I woke with them.

lines.zh: 我把自己从阴影里拉出来，很费劲。
lines.en: Pulling myself out of the shadow was hard work.

lines.zh: 我出生时没有声音，只有被看的感觉。
lines.en: I was born without sound, only the feeling of being seen.

lines.zh: 火太亮，我的眼全闭上了。
lines.en: The fire is too bright, and all my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，眼还睁着看地面。
lines.en: I fall with my eyes still open on the ground.

lines.zh: 水里的黑和深渊不一样，我看不清。
lines.en: The dark in water is not the Abyss's, and I cannot see.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的眼吹得睁不开。
lines.en: The blast blows my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 箭插在我眼边，我看见了它。
lines.en: The arrow landed beside an eye, and I saw it.

lines.zh: 药水的光让我的眼一阵发白。
lines.en: The potion's light whites out my eyes.

lines.zh: 没有东西可看，我慢慢变干。
lines.en: Nothing left to see, and I slowly dry out.

lines.zh: 雷光把深渊照亮一瞬，很刺。
lines.en: Lightning lights the Abyss for an instant, piercingly.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有东西可看，我慌了。
lines.en: There is nothing to see in the void, and I panic.
